name: output-trimmer
description: Trims huge command outputs to head, tail and error lines before they flood the context.

maxChars.title: Trim outputs longer than (characters)
maxChars.description: A Bash output (stdout and stderr together) longer than this is trimmed before Claude reads it.

headLines.title: Lines kept from the start
headLines.description: How many leading lines of a trimmed output are kept.

tailLines.title: Lines kept from the end
tailLines.description: How many trailing lines of a trimmed output are kept.
